name: Sennheiser HD 820 (AutoEq average measurement EQ, same L/R curve)
target: AutoEq over-ear target; FIR normalized to 0 dB at 1 kHz
channelClaim: The same average-measurement EQ is applied to L/R; not independent L/R calibration and does not correct unit channel mismatch.
derivation: scripts/build-sennheiser-hd-820-average-profile.mjs synthesized the published 10-band PEQ at 48 kHz into 8192 taps and normalized it at 1 kHz. AutoEq's -6.4 dB preamp is intentionally excluded.
deviceRevision: Sennheiser HD 820 as identified by AutoEq HypetheSonics
playbackState: Passive wired over-ear headphone; source measurement state is defined by HypetheSonics
measurementRig: HypetheSonics over-ear measurement data as processed by AutoEq
